title: When I was a student
goal: Talk about earlier times with -kA (çagakam, talypkam) and link actions with -(Y)p.

intro.text: `-kA` on a noun or adjective means **when … was** or **while**: *çagakam*, when I was a child (*-m* for **I**, *-ň* for **you**); *Çaý gyzgynka iç*, drink the tea while it's hot. `-(Y)p` joins actions of one person: *Bazara baryp, çörek aldym*, I went to the market and bought bread.

vocab.en: to stop off, to drop in (on the way)
now (from now on); any more (with a negative)

exercises.question: How do you say **when I was a child**?

why.2: *çagadym* is a whole sentence, **I was a child**; **when** needs *-ka*.

exercises.prompt: When I was a student, I lived in Ashgabat.
accept: Talypkam Aşgabatda ýaşadym.
Men talypkam Aşgabatda ýaşadym.
exercises.explain: *talyp* + *-ka* + *-m*: when I was a student; the past *ýaşadym* gives the tense.

exercises.en: Drink the tea while it's hot!

accept: ka

exercises.explain: *gyzgyn* + *-ka*: while (it is) hot; nothing after it for **it**.

accept: On my way back from work, I stopped at the shop.
On my way back from work, I stopped at the store.
On my way back from work, I [stopped by|dropped in at|dropped into] the [shop|store].
On my way home from work, I [stopped at|stopped by|dropped in at|dropped into] the [shop|store].
While I was coming from work, I [stopped at|stopped by|dropped in at] the [shop|store].
As I was coming [back|home] from work, I [stopped at|stopped by|dropped in at] the [shop|store].
I [stopped at|stopped by|dropped in at] the [shop|store] on my way [back|home] from work.
On my way back from work, I stopped at a [shop|store].

exercises.prompt: Let's go home while it's light.
accept: Howa ýagtyka öýe gideli.
Howa ýagtyka öýe [gideliň|gaýdaly|gaýdalyň].
Ýagtyka öýe [gideli|gideliň|gaýdaly|gaýdalyň].

exercises.en: I went to the market and bought bread.

accept: yp

reject.why: Here one action follows the other: *baryp*, went and. *baranda* would be **when I went**.
Only the last verb takes the tense and the person: *baryp, … aldym*.

exercises.explain: *bar-* + *-yp*: went (and); *aldym* gives the past and **I** for both.

accept: I crossed the street and went into the shop.
I crossed the street and went into the store.
I crossed the street and [entered|went in to] the [shop|store].
I crossed the road and [went into|entered] the [shop|store].
Öýe gelip, nahar iýdi.

exercises.question: *Indi men talyp däl.* What does it mean?
options: I'm not a student any more.

why.1: **Not yet** would be *entek*: *Men entek talyp däl*.

exercises.prompt: Where did you live when you were a child?
accept: Çagakaň nirede ýaşadyň?
Sen çagakaň nirede ýaşadyň?
(Siz) çagakaňyz nirede ýaşadyňyz?
exercises.explain: *çaga* + *-ka* + *-ň*: when you were a child; *ýaşadyň*, you lived.

accept: When it got dark, we went home.
When it got dark, we [headed|came|went back] home.
When it [grew|became] dark, we [went|headed|came] home.
We [went|headed] home when it got dark.
